selected.name: Pepsi
selected.description: Pepsi is a global beverage brand known for its popular cola soft drinks and other flavored beverages.

alternatives.name: Pepsi Max
alternatives.description: Pepsi Max is a sugar-free, maximum taste cola beverage available primarily in Asian, European, and Australia/New Zealand markets.

alternatives.name: Pepsi Wild Cherry
alternatives.description: Pepsi Wild Cherry is a cherry-flavored variant of Pepsi cola known for its unique cherry flavor and sweet, crisp taste.

alternatives.name: Pepsi Nitro
alternatives.description: Pepsi Nitro is a nitrogen-infused cola soft drink by PepsiCo, known for its creamy, smooth texture and smaller bubbles.

alternatives.name: Diet Pepsi
alternatives.description: Diet Pepsi is a diet carbonated cola soft drink with zero sugar, zero calories, and zero carbs, produced by PepsiCo.

properties.description: An iconic, globally available carbonated soft drink that stands as a flagship product of its parent corporation. With a history rooted in bold, refreshing cola flavors, the brand has maintained its position through heavy investment in music, sports, and entertainment partnerships. It serves as a mass-market staple appealing to a wide demographic looking for classic refreshment in casual and social settings. The brand continues to innovate with zero-sugar variants and modern packaging to remain relevant to contemporary consumer tastes.
properties.short_description: Pepsi is a global beverage brand known for its popular cola soft drinks and other flavored beverages.
